System Power has been exclusively developed for system builders who offer complete PC systems. System Power power supplies cannot be purchased as single products in any shop. If you wish to acquire a be quiet! power supply for the assembly, you get further information at Straight Power and Dark Power Pro. Please search the "where-to-buy section” for the next dealer close by.
The be quiet! S6-SYS-UA-350W convinces through its excellent quality and its perfected technology. That power supplies of the S6-SYS-UA series have been given an energy-saving design, offering a high efficiency of over 80%. The cable connectors are optimized for system building. The be quiet! S6-SYS-UA-350W has been manufactured in accordance with the ATX 12V 2.2 standard and it uses 2 separate 12V cables (DUAL RAIL) for an optimal power supply and stable operations.
